notes.title: New version updated. Multiplayer Mode
notes.content:
Multiplayer Mode has been completed after 2 months of developing. Now you can invite your friends to play with you this weekend. Hope you have a good time.  

[list][*]The Multiplayer Mode start from level 4.
[*]At the same level, up to 3 players can play together.
[*]You can use voice to chat with the other players.
[*]You can choose Multiplayer Mode or Single Challenge Mode when you start a level. 
[/list]

Btw, I found an anchor who recorded all of the levels at YouTube. Recommended it to you. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4Kmf5yD3Z0M&list=PLh4hvzSHde4EjyguAwYIP4Z8pfYdFC_E6

notes.title: Deadly Hunter is officially released
notes.content:
[b] Now Deadly Hunter is officially released[/b]
For this release, We've done a great effort.although all of it's services are free,the experience won't be discounted.We hope we could get the great support  form you.

Let's talk about this version. besides some changes to release, we have done the following changes:
[list]
    [*]Open the Endless challenge for the High-end player,because we found that some players complete the final stage
    [*]Supporting Oculus , we've done a lot of adaptation for Touch
    [*]Shooting optimization
[/list]

We do hope that you enjoy it.

notes.title: New version updated. More freer combat
notes.content:
In order to give players a better experience,we updated the game.

[b]Transfer is not restricted:[/b]
[list]
    [*]we opened the transfer，now you can transfer at any level, including in combat
    [*]Moreover we are not limit the trap placement，you can use them at any time
[/list]

[b]Escort mode：[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed the trouble issue that the elf fall under the board
    [*]Increase the elf's max hp，make it easier to survive
[/list]

[b]Some modifications：[/b]
[list]
    [*]Complete the guide of two different shooting modes
    [*]Fixed the trouble issue that arrow can't take out easily when you shot away
    [*]Increase the player's hp when he gets rid of moribund state
[/list]

notes.title: New version updated. Another way to aim
notes.content:
[h1]Another way to aim[/h1]
We have received the feedback that someone want to aim by move the right hand around. Now, we have finished it.
Btw,we optimized our shock feedback, You'll feel more real with  the controller  when you pull  the string.

The method to change the type of aim.
[olist]
[*] First, you can open the setting by  touching the home button when you are inside any stage.
[*] Then, you can see the setting about  aim types and choose your favorite way.
[*] how to switch the control method:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28038942/36cf372dd648e6b6a5358a51632c0d42db3eac11.jpg[/img]
[/olist]

If you prefer this way, please have a try and give us some feedback. Thank you!

[h1]Trap upgrade[/h1]
A player said the poison clip cann't poison the monster,We reproduced and fixed it.
